maggi.overview: Nestle Maggi 2‑Minute Masala Noodles (70 g) is a fortified instant noodle sold across India.

praised.text: Manufacturer states each pack contains 15 % of daily iron requirement to address iron deficiency.

criticised.text: 2015 FSSAI order cited lead levels above 2.5 ppm in several batches, leading to state‑level recalls and product withdrawal.

safety.text: 2015 FSSAI recall order directed withdrawal of all 9 approved variants due to lead contamination and misleading “No added MSG” claim.

facts.text: Product is fortified with iron as per Nestle’s marketing claim.
